outcome: Ureteric injuries leading to ureterovaginal fistula (UVF)
cohort: 18 cases of UVFs due to iatrogenic ureteric injury managed at University College Hospital (UCH) from January 2012 to December 2017
finding: Caesarean section was the most common cause of ureteric injury leading to UVF at a Nigerian hospital, suggesting potential training deficiencies in performing this procedure.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was found to be the most common cause of ureteric injury, with the majority occurring after emergency caesarean section.
